Anthony Flores

Anthony Flores is a brand designer and art director based in London, creating visual systems for music, culture and lifestyle brands. Formerly at Sony Music / The Orchard, his work includes projects for RAYE, Lancey Foux, RCA Records, CUPRA and Snap Inc.

Services

Creative direction, art direction, visual identities, campaign design, album artwork, packaging, merchandise, stage visuals and motion design.
